_spec: The film of scenes — « option 3 », chosen by the owner on 2026-10-14 after the benchmark; it replaces the single 21-s flow of storyboard.json (docs/design/pro-app-preview.md, version 1). A WORKING storyboard: the scene budgets are targets, the real takes decide, and nothing here is final until the owner signs it off. Takes are relative to --takes: s1/take.mov and s1/gestures.json, and so on — one take a scene; the gesture ids below are the ones each take's log must use. README.md « Version 2 — scenes » says what every value does.
_never_shown: sign-in; « Mon abonnement » or an offer; KYC (« Vérification »); a « Compte de démonstration — … » message; a system alert; a legible phone number; the « Prestations » price list as a scene. S6 never reaches the « Contact » block (the salon's phone): the scroll stops short of it — checked by eye on the take, the tool cannot read it.
